study type: In vitro experimental study with ex vivo human tissue analysis
cohort: The study utilized human amnion epithelial cells in culture and fetal membranes obtained from spontaneous preterm births (SPTB).
finding: Inflammation, specifically induced by TNF-a but not LPS (infection), promotes non-canonical activation of EMT in amnion epithelial cells, potentially contributing to fetal membrane weakening associated with spontaneous preterm birth.
cross-section timing: Membranes were screened from spontaneous preterm birth (SPTB); in vitro treatments were for 72 hours.
